Zeta Global Teams Up with Fireworks to Unveil New Specialized Athena Inference Models Using NVIDIA NemotronRead News

AthenaOS

The Enterprise Intelligence Operating System

Build Around Your Ambition and Turn Intelligence into Growth

AthenaOS transforms how businesses operate and how marketers work. Instead of navigating software and assembling context across disconnected tools, simply tell Athena what you want to achieve.

AthenaOS brings together enterprise knowledge with customer and market signals to understand what matters, determine what to do next, take action, and learn from every outcome—building a clearer path from ambition to growth. Start with marketing, then extend that intelligence across your business.

Your Intent Becomes the Interface

AthenaOS transforms how businesses and marketers work by starting with the outcome—not disconnected tools, dashboards, or workflows. You set the intent, and Athena unifies customer, business, and market signals to coordinate action, learn, and improve. As a result, your teams spend less time managing technology and more time making better decisions and driving growth.

The Connected Intelligence Loop

AthenaOS is the connected intelligence layer across Zeta applications and interoperable enterprise systems, helping teams move from intent to action with greater speed and confidence.

Know the opportunity

Start with your objective. AthenaOS organizes the relevant customer, performance, enterprise, and market context around it.

Decide what should happen next

AthenaOS applies intelligence and reasoning to understand performance, identify opportunities and risks, and recommend the highest-value next decision.

Coordinate action across the system

AthenaOS brings together the applications, agents, workflows, and activation systems required to move from decision to execution across the customer lifecycle.

Prove what worked & learn from it

Every outcome creates a new signal. AthenaOS measures impact, feeds learning back into the shared intelligence foundation, and improves the speed and quality of what happens next.

AthenaOS Goes Wherever Work Happens

AthenaOS brings enterprise intelligence into environments where teams already work, not just another destination they have to learn and manage.

Through headless capabilities and Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectivity, AthenaOS securely brings the right context, intelligence, and actions into existing tools, workflows and AI experiences. One system of intelligence, available wherever the work needs to happen.

Intelligence Powered by Your Context

AthenaOS is built on Zeta’s intelligent AI infrastructure—Data Cloud, proprietary identity capabilities, enterprise data, real-time signals, connected systems, and purpose-built reasoning—to create a living understanding of your business that strengthens customer relationships and informs enterprise intelligence.

  • Teams navigate products, dashboards, reports, and handoffs.

  • Context is manually assembled after the moment has passed.

  • AI helps complete tasks, but people coordinate the work.

  • Measurement happens after execution.

  • Teams direct the system through an outcome.

  • A living view of customer, business, and market context informs the next decision.

  • AthenaOS coordinates people, applications, agents, and actions around a shared objective.

  • Outcomes prove value and continuously improve future decisions.

AthenaOS

See the Future of Enterprise Intelligence

Explore how AthenaOS is creating a new way to move from business intent to coordinated growth.
